title: OFG Bancorp Announces Appointment of Mari Evelyn Rodríguez as Chief Operating Officer
summary: SAN JUAN, Puerto Rico, November 23, 2026--OFG Bancorp (NYSE: OFG), the financial holding company for Oriental Bank, announced today the appointment of Mari Evelyn Rodríguez as Chief Operating Officer of OFG Bancorp, effective January 1, 2027. In this role, she will report directly to José R. Fernández, OFG’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and oversee the company’s strategy and operations.

title: OFG Bancorp Increases Regular Quarterly Common Stock Cash Dividend to $0.40
summary: SAN JUAN, Puerto Rico, November 02, 2026--OFG Bancorp (NYSE: OFG) today announced its Board of Directors increased the regular quarterly cash dividend by 14% to $0.40 per common share for the quarter ending December 31, 2026. The dividend is payable January 15, 2027, to holders of record at December 31, 2026.
